We do not oppose the hiring of a lady teacher because we are particularly preju ¬ diced against them , for we are not , and believe that some of the most reliable and able teachers that bless our land to - day are ladies . The point is right here : If we cannot afford to hire more than one teacher at present , and we are of tbo opinion that we cannot , could a lady teacher , with no more than ordinary abili ¬ ty do a school of one hundred scholars justice * Every intelligent reasoner in the county will agree with us when we answer most emphatically , no . If our county was able to stand the extra ex ¬ pense we would be In favor of hiring two teachers instead of one . Could we see our way clear in this direction we would then favor the engagement of a lady teacher whose duties it would be to give instructions to the primary department , leaving the more advanced portion of the school in the haads of a capable gentle ¬ man teacher .
